_EXAMPLE_ONLY: Illustrative layout - NOT the real gateway API. The gateway's actual URL, auth and JSON layout are still needed. Set Settings > Communication > Gateway API to match the real reply (readings path + field names).

_settings_for_this_example.auth_value: <kept on the server, entered on the Settings page>

_notes: id is matched against each tag's Source ID (Tags page), then its PLC symbol, then its tag ID.
value 0 with good quality is a valid zero; null or bad quality marks the tag OFFLINE (last value kept, never shown as live).
ts may be epoch seconds, epoch milliseconds or ISO 8601; ISO without a zone is read as Asia/Kolkata. Blank ts field = time of the poll.
Also accepted: an object keyed by id, e.g. {"T_01": 81.3} or {"T_01": {"value": 81.3, "ts": 1793770000}}.
